trigger: If wraith_injured: Tallmen corner the column on the ice. The ONE signposted choice that can kill Wraith.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Whiteout. Then shapes in it. Two. Then three. Tall. Circling the column at the edge of the flares.

nodes.speaker: wraith
nodes.text: [Limping. Hurt since the sweep. She puts herself between the column and the dark anyway.]

nodes.speaker: carly
nodes.text: Flares are almost gone. Braith. They're testing us. They're going to come in.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: SHE'S HURT. IF YOU GIVE THIS ORDER, WRAITH WILL NOT COME BACK. The column escapes. She doesn't.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: You take your hand off her collar. She looks up at you. She was ready either way.

nodes.speaker: wraith
nodes.text: [She stands. She doesn't limp. For ten seconds she's the dog they trained, and better.]

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: The column runs. Behind you, in the whiteout, a long silence. Then nothing at all.

nodes.speaker: carly
nodes.text: [Her hand in yours. She doesn't say anything. She doesn't let go for a mile.]

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Forty pounds of dog over your shoulders. The column runs. Something hits the back of the line. Two people don't make it.

nodes.speaker: wraith
nodes.text: [Her nose in your collar the whole way. Breathing. Breathing.]

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: The last flares go up red. They come in one at a time, testing. You fire until the rifle's empty.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: They pull back into the white. One of them stays down. The column limps on. Wraith limps with it.
